title: GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of F(x), with every component f_i convex and continuously differentiable; strong convexity is not assumed.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,x) returns the exact component gradient ∇f_i(x). The index and point are selectable; replies have no oracle error, regardless of history or seed.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same oracle call also returns the exact component value f_i(x).

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For each component, whenever ‖∇f_i(x+θ(y−x))‖ ≤ M for all θ∈[0,1], one has ‖∇f_i(x)−∇f_i(y)‖ ≤ (L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Here L0>0 and L1≥0; no global Lipschitz gradient bound is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space with a measurable-space structure. A minimizer x* satisfies ‖x0−x*‖≤R, F(x0)−F(x*)≤Δ, and (1/n)Σ_i ‖∇f_i(x*)‖≤G. This bounds average component gradient norms, not their squares, and permits nonzero component gradients at x*. All parameters, including n,L0,L1,G,R,Δ,ε,x0, are public; component functions and the minimizer are hidden. R,Δ,ε>0 and G≥0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output X with integrable objective gap and E[F(X)−F(x*)]≤ε for a global minimizer x*.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee is in expectation over algorithm and oracle seeds. Execution uses a fixed upper budget of component value-and-gradient calls, rather than an expected stopping cost.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and executeWithTrace; supplied result budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The finite-sum convex formulation uses componentwise gradient-dependent smoothness and an average component-gradient norm bound at a minimizer, rather than standard global smoothness or a common-minimizer assumption.

descriptionHtml:
Generalized Smooth Finite-Sum Minimization

We consider minimizing F(x)=n−1∑i=1nfi(x) on a real Hilbert space E, where n≥1 is an integer. Each component fi:E→R is convex, continuously differentiable, and (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1≥0. A global minimizer x⋆ satisfies bounds on its distance from a given starting point x0∈E, the initial objective gap, and the average component-gradient norm at x⋆. At a query (i,x), the oracle returns (fi(x),∇fi(x)). For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable objective gap satisfying EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈EF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is equipped with a measurable structure. The algorithm receives E, n, L0, L1, G≥0, R>0, Δ>0, ε>0, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Component convexity). For every i∈{1,…,n}, x,y∈E, and t∈[0,1], fi((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)fi(x)+tfi(y).

Assumption 2 (Generalized smoothness). Each fi is Fréchet differentiable everywhere, and ∇fi:E→E is continuous. For every i∈{1,…,n}, x,y∈E, and M∈R satisfying ∥∇fi(x+θ(y−x))∥≤Mfor all θ∈[0,1], we have ∥∇fi(x)−∇fi(y)∥≤(L0+L1M)∥x−y∥.

Assumption 3 (Minimizer and initial bounds). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ,1n∑i=1n∥∇fi(x⋆)∥≤G.

The algorithm may query any component at any point in E; each query returns the exact component value and gradient together. After the allotted oracle calls, its output x¯ must be measurable, its objective gap must be integrable under P, and it must satisfy EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
On a real Hilbert space, F=n−1∑i=1nfi, n≥1, with convex fi and continuous gradients satisfying ∥∇fi(x)−∇fi(y)∥≤(L0+L1supz∈[x,y]∥∇fi(z)∥)∥x−y∥. Here L0,R,Δ,ε>0 and L1,G≥0; some minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, and n−1∑i∥∇fi(x⋆)∥≤G. Exact component value–gradient queries are available. The target is a measurable returned point with integrable gap and ∫(F(out(ω))−F(x⋆))dP(ω)≤ε, where P is the algorithm’s probability law.

import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory Set

namespace LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum

open OracleTemplate
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  n : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero n]
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE Params.measurableE Params.nonzero

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ
  Query p := Fin p.n × p.E
  Reply p := ℝ × p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.L0 ∧ 0 ≤ q.L1 ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 < q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f oracle :=
    (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ univ (f i)) ∧
    (∀ k seed i x, (oracle.answer k (0, (i, x)) seed).1 = f i x) ∧
    (∀ k seed i x, HasGradientAt (f i) (oracle.answer k (0, (i, x)) seed).2 x) ∧
    (∀ i, Continuous (gradient (f i))) ∧
    (∀ i x y M, (∀ θ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖gradient (f i) (x + θ • (y - x))‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ≤ (q.L0 + q.L1 * M) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn (FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) univ xstar ∧
      ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f q.x0 -
        FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f xstar ≤ q.Δ ∧
      (q.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) xstar‖ ≤ q.G)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f (output ω) -
        FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f (output ω) -
        FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothFiniteSum
